r13_contract.comparisonModel: The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest displacement.

test_cases.rationale: Selected UIWL displacement equals the greatest of three represented waterline-case displacements.
Maximum selection is invariant to graph/case ordering.
A single represented UIWL case is itself the maximum.
upperIceWaterlineDisplacement is present but is not the greatest represented case displacement.
The selected UIWL displacement is missing.
The selected UIWL displacement uses the wrong unit instead of frozen kt.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
